## INDEX.md entry

```text
- **ci-github-actions-security**: A GitHub Actions workflow, composite action or Dependabot file gained a weakness (each finding names its rule, CWE and fix). Fix it as the finding says. A person who has reviewed one may keep it with '# chock: allow <rule id>' on that line and commit from their own shell; in the agent only a line already committed in HEAD counts, so an agent asks the person rather than writing the comment. Also checked in the agent: before a write, or at the end of the turn, depending on the agent.
```
